headline: Guinea-Bissau raises 7,500 billion FCFA on UMOA financial market
summary: Guinea-Bissau raised 7.5 billion CFA francs on the UMOA financial market. The full article is restricted to members.
why: Treasury issuances on the regional UMOA market show how West African governments finance themselves and signal demand for their debt.
original_headline: La Guinée Bissau lève 7,500 milliards de FCFA sur le marché financier de l’UMOA
